reply: runner reply (PWRunnerRunResult) | the host; response schema; shape golden

B4: per-phase release/acquire publication; exact ordinal before actions after a validated continuous-time decision; disposition from raw facts; collection status agrees with validator observations; native result publication and fresh-read consistency before claims | Terminal publication erases accepted token storage, releases done and exits. Poll stop, deadline and disposition remain independent.
